caption:
Greek chicken thighs with butter beans, olives, and artichokes all on one sheet pan. Easy enough for weeknights but flavorful enough to impress.

For the recipe, search 'Food by Maria Greek Chicken Thighs' 👇
author: Foodbymaria
transcript: If you make a delicious Greek yogurt chicken marinade, drown your chicken in it, then add potatoes, butter beans, artichokes, and olives to a sheet pan and bake it, you'll have just made the most effortless weeknight dinner. Welcome back to episode 97 of All Things Greek. When you're craving Greek food, you probably think about Greek lemon potatoes, but have you ever tried them cooked with juicy lemony Greek yogurt chicken thighs on top? Your mind is about to be blown. It's such a simple dish with little to no mess. Be sure to follow me for more Greek food.
title: Greek Chicken Thighs Sheet Pan Dinner
one_liner: Greek yogurt-marinated chicken thighs baked with potatoes, butter beans, artichokes, and olives on one sheet pan.
key_points: Marinate chicken thighs in a Greek yogurt-based lemon marinade
Combine chicken with potatoes, butter beans, artichokes, and olives on a single sheet pan
Bake everything together for a low-mess, flavorful weeknight dinner
Recipe searchable as 'Food by Maria Greek Chicken Thighs'

instructions: 1. Prepare Greek yogurt chicken marinade with lemon and coat chicken thighs thoroughly.
2. Arrange marinated chicken thighs on a sheet pan.
3. Add potatoes, butter beans, artichokes, and olives around the chicken.
4. Bake until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are tender.
